question: Where should the soles of the feet be arranged in relation to the buttocks?
premises: The soles of the feet are to be placed against each other.
The position is below the buttock mass.
The arrangement is prescribed to the brāhmaṇa.
inference: The soles of the feet should be arranged together below the buttocks.
plain_english: O brāhmaṇa, one should arrange the soles of the feet together below the buttocks.
